It was from Recanati, not from the biblical commentary of Moses ben Nahman of Gerona or the writings of Eleazar of Worms, that Pico learned that all peculiarities of the Masorah represented mysteries of the ten seflrot (Conclusio xxxiii). It was likewise in Recanati, and not by his own wits, that Pico found the shrewd combination of texts that brought out some particular points, such as the proper attitude at prayer (Conclusio xxxiv).
